local_plan.decision: ADD a dedicated RouteMission chapter-2 component; do NOT edit CourierMission/VehicleInteraction. It observes (never reinterprets) legacy MissionComplete true-edge and adds ONE real objective: drive the coupe east through the open X22 alley junction to a fixed east-street cache, exit, and place it. Red cases all must yield no RouteComplete: (1) no input -> chapter inactive, cache never reached; (2) remote F -> proximity gate fails; (3) wrong actor/mode -> F inside car (must be on-foot) or on-foot before arrival does nothing; (4) stale carry/reset -> after R, cache hidden, RouteStage=0, F at old anchor ignored; (5) early ending -> F before legacy complete, cache object does not yet exist so cannot shortcut. This short milestone is explicitly NOT ten-minute acceptance.
local_plan.first_objective: Chapter 2 "East Dead-Drop": only AFTER legacy MissionComplete true-edge, spawn a reused-mesh cache marker at fixed anchor (50,0.6,18) on east-street pavement (top Y0.14) inside X22..60/Z8..28. Player drives W through the open X22 junction to within ~6m (vehicle "near"), presses E to exit (real vehicle->foot transition), walks within 1.5m on-foot, presses F to place -> RouteStage=2, RouteComplete=true, cache lights green, separate HUD reads "ROUTE COMPLETE". No timer on chapter 2.
local_plan.first_source_scope: Create Assets/Game/RouteMission.cs (self-hosted stationary GameObject root, mirroring CourierMission.Install style). Add two static members to LoopSignals.cs: public static int RouteStage; public static bool RouteComplete;. Add ONE line in Bootstrap.Create after Combat.Install: RouteMission.Install(body, cam). Mission.cs and VehicleInteraction.cs are NOT touched (respects the polish-editor protection).
local_plan.legacy_compatibility: CourierMission's parcel (3.6,0.45,3.2), pad/beacon (1,0.14,26), 30s DEADLINE, stage 0/1/2/3 logic, fail/retry, combat, camera, collisions all untouched. RouteMission flips RouteStage 0->1, cache appears, HUD reads "new drop". local_plan.pacing_path: Toward 540..660s varied connected play, each chapter gated by real arrival+input (no idle waits, no timer locks): C1 courier grab/deliver w/ rival combat (~30s); C2 east-street cache drop (drive+on-foot place); C3 alley return-pickup under pursuit; C4 evade: drive until derived PursuitLevel reaches 0 (already distance-derived); C5 final handoff in newer street once its visual gate is accepted, ending on a RouteEnding signal from real Health/pursuit (clean-getaway vs war-worn). RouteStage advances on genuine world events only; total ~6 chapters x ~90-110s real traversal/combat. Visual FIX items (junction-through capture, reused-mesh boundaries, restored HUD text, back-off return cam) are absorbed here as objective-driven framing, not as a separate camera scope.
